entities.title: UI
entities.summary: The cast and pickups as canvas shapes, the drawing of the island and the words over it, the controls and the sound.
entities.purpose: Turns the engine's Game and its events into what the player sees and hears on a 336 × 420 canvas drawn at the screen's own resolution, and keys, swipes, on-screen buttons and a gamepad into one Input a step.
boundaries: Decides nothing about the game: the engine does. Renderer.draw reads a Game and never changes it.
No image files and no sound files: every character and pickup is drawn with canvas shapes in art.ts, and every sound is made with Web Audio in sound.ts.
Does not run itself: the page (src/main.ts) owns the loop, calls Controls.read once a step and Renderer.draw once a frame.
